items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How did that whole business of Harvey Estran and the live studio orchestra and everything originate? ... [INTERVIEWEE] About four or five years now.

ctx.x: When the situation arises, I have to stop and think about where I am and what I'm doing and then I freeze. I can't write for a closet. I can write if somebody needs it; need is probably the basis of it. It there is a need I'll do it, but if not, I diddle.
How did that whole business of Harvey Estran and the live studio orchestra and everything originate? How long has that been going?
About four or five years now.
